regions.finding: Generic lithiation/1,3-lithium-shift/transmetalation/Pd-coupling network leading to generic 1,1- and 1,3-diarylallenes; classified as a general scheme, not a reported experiment.

regions.region: lower-right Table 1 reaction header and rows 1-7
regions.finding: Sixteen populated base/temperature condition cells were extracted as separate optimization records, including the two explicit no-lithiation failures at -78 °C; dash cells were treated as unreported, not as experiments.
Lithiation-temperature header, general 1H-NMR/CH2Br2 yield basis, and the isolated-yield exception for entry 1/LDA were assigned to their own cells.

regions.region: left-column article text, author note, and supporting-information notice
regions.finding: Introductory/prior-work discussion and bibliographic matter contain no additional fully specified experiment; the article says SI is available elsewhere, but no SI file was supplied or associated here.

unresolved: Table 1 does not state participant quantities, solvent, atmosphere, workup, or purification.
The variable 100:0-0:100 ratios are preserved as reported ranges; no single ratio or yield is inferred.
SI availability is mentioned, but no SI was explicitly provided or associated.

regions.finding: Cross-page discussion of the -78 °C LDA cell and the -20/-40 °C nBuLi/tBuLi cells was merged into the existing Table 1 records rather than duplicated.

regions.region: mid-left Scheme 2, four x-time rows and caption
regions.finding: Four independent room-temperature-time experiments were extracted (1 h, 2 h, 5 h, and >11 h), retaining NMR yields/ratios and the >11 h unidentified-mixture failure.
One TMEDA-promoted sequential experiment was extracted with its five timed/temperature stages and 94% 1H-NMR yield of 2a.
Sixteen substrate-scope rows were extracted separately with Ar1/CH2R/Ar2I, base, lithiation temperature, yield basis, and product ratio; entry 14 alone uses the footnoted NMR-yield basis.
Condition-A quantities and early stages were merged with the continuation on page 3 into Table 2 entry 1; no duplicate procedure record was created.
Mechanistic interpretation is qualitative and explicitly says the mechanism is unclear; no separate mechanism experiment was fabricated.

unresolved: Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 omit participant quantities, solvent, atmosphere, workup, and purification.
Table 2 entries 3-16 lack exact quantities and full procedures in the supplied main-text pages.
The coupling durations in the typical procedures are TLC endpoints rather than numeric times.
Condition B has a source-label conflict: prose says 1b, while Table 2 entry 2 and the depicted/ratio assignment indicate 2a.

regions.region: upper-left continuation of typical procedure A
regions.finding: Workup, purification, isolated mass/yield, and characterization for 1a were merged into Table 2 entry 1, whose procedure starts on page 2.
LDA, substrate, THF, ZnBr2, Pd catalyst, iodobenzene quantities, timings, atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated mass/yield, and characterization were merged into Table 2 entry 2.

regions.region: condition-B product sentence and characterization block
regions.finding: The printed product label reads 1b, but its 84% result corresponds to Table 2 entry 2 (1a:2a = 0:100); this contradiction is preserved as unresolved instead of silently corrected.
Prior-literature citations and characterization references are not experiments reported in this paper and were not converted into experiment records.

unresolved: The condition-B product-label conflict (1b versus the Table 2/structure assignment 2a) requires external source review.
Both coupling steps are reported as proceeding until TLC completion, without numeric durations.
No supporting-information file was supplied or explicitly associated.
